entrypoints.summary: The recorded order owner invokes SolverNetInbox.close(id) after fillDeadline plus CLOSE_BUFFER while the source order is still Pending.

affected_components.role: The report excerpt shows the timeout-close checks, state transition, and deposit transfer.

causal_paths.kind: cross-domain confirmation absence to local timeout repayment

code_slices.fixed: The reported resolution adds checks causing close to revert if OmniPortal, global xsubmit, or route-specific xsubmit is paused.
code_slices.surrounding_context: A destination-chain fill is intended to cause a cross-rollup source update to Filled; unavailable confirmation instead leaves the source state Pending.
code_slices.vulnerable: close requires Pending status, recorded owner, and expiry of fillDeadline plus CLOSE_BUFFER; it then records Closed and transfers the deposit to the owner.

negative_controls: A call before fillDeadline plus CLOSE_BUFFER reverts OrderStillValid.
Under the reported resolution, close reverts when the relevant portal or xsubmit pause condition is present.
observability.positive_marker: The report's close excerpt records Status.Closed and calls _transferDeposit for header.owner.

preconditions: The order is executed on the destination chain.
The cross-rollup fulfillment confirmation cannot reach or be applied on the source chain because the Omni network is down or OmniPortal is paused.
The source order remains Pending until fillDeadline plus CLOSE_BUFFER has expired.
The caller is the recorded order owner.

sources.concept: cross-domain fulfillment confirmation unavailable during portal or network pause

impact.affected_asset: Deposit associated with a destination-fulfilled SolverNet order.
impact.attacker_capability: An order owner can invoke the timeout-close path during confirmation unavailability and receive the deposited amount back.
impact.security_effect: Source-chain deposit can be reclaimed after the corresponding order was fulfilled on the destination chain.

causal_trace.summary: A solver executes an order on the destination chain, but its Omni Core cross-rollup fulfillment confirmation does not arrive at the source inbox during Omni network downtime or when OmniPortal remains paused beyond the expected period.
The source-chain order remains Pending rather than being updated to Filled even though the order was fulfilled on the destination chain.

close(id) accepts a Pending order from its owner after fillDeadline plus the six-hour CLOSE_BUFFER, writes Status.Closed, and transfers the deposit to header.owner without an authoritative fulfillment or portal-operational-state check.
The owner can reclaim the source-chain deposit despite destination-chain fulfillment; the audit characterizes exploiting this delay as an opportunity to steal funds.

failure.operation: SolverNetInbox.close(bytes32 id) transitions the stale Pending order to Closed and calls _transferDeposit(id, header.owner).

primary_invariant.statement: A source-chain timeout closure and deposit repayment must not be authorized for an order already fulfilled on the destination chain when fulfillment confirmation is unavailable.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The closure decision uses local Pending state, owner identity, and elapsed deadline buffer; a delayed or paused cross-rollup confirmation leaves that local state stale and permits repayment.

quality.review_notes: The primary audit report supplies the finding narrative, vulnerable close() excerpt, and a reported resolution in commit ea808d7, but the bundle lacks an independently fetched source snapshot, patch diff, test, transaction trace, or reproduction. The fund-theft characterization and effectiveness of the reported fix remain auditor-attributed.

remediation.invariant_restored: close must revert when OmniPortal, xsubmit globally, or xsubmit for the relevant route is paused, preventing timeout repayment while the report-defined confirmation path is unavailable.

state_context.attacker_state_setup: The order has been fulfilled on the destination chain, while downtime or a paused portal prevents the confirmation from being applied to the source inbox before the close buffer expires.
data_structure_invariants: A source Pending status must accurately exclude destination-fulfilled orders before it authorizes deposit repayment.
Deadline expiration alone is insufficient when cross-domain confirmation service is unavailable.

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: The report identifies a fixed value of six hours; the owner must wait until fillDeadline plus this buffer has expired.
numeric_domains.name: CLOSE_BUFFER

state_context.state_machine: The reported lifecycle relevant to this finding is Pending on the source chain, Filled when destination fulfillment confirmation is applied, or Closed when the owner passes the timeout-close path.
